input.normalization: scalar mean/std computed from each experiment's training images only

cnn.architecture: Conv5x5-s2 1->8, GroupNorm, ReLU; Conv3x3-s2 8->16, GroupNorm, ReLU; Conv3x3-s2 16->24, GroupNorm, ReLU; Conv3x3-s2 24->32, GroupNorm, ReLU; AdaptiveAvgPool4x4; Linear512->32, ReLU, Dropout0.10; Linear32->1

samePoseRepeat.note: same-pose repeats are correlated and are not independent samples

labelStability.stableMainAnalysis: pose repeats all have the same Unity label
labelStability.unstableStratum: reported separately and retained without relabeling

decisionProcedure.FAIL: CNN stable-case memorization accuracy median across seeds <0.98 or preprocessing/integrity fails
decisionProcedure.PASS: Integrity passes; median stable-case memorization >=0.98; median same-pose stable recall >=0.80 with FPR <=0.05; and median pooled cross-family balanced accuracy exceeds both frozen spatial-v2 and structural-v4 by >=0.05, with recall >=0.60 and FPR <=0.20
decisionProcedure.INCONCLUSIVE: Memorization/integrity passes but the complete PASS criteria are not met
decisionProcedure.dependency: R4-B is allowed only after R4-A PASS
